title: Monospace font is not monospaced with keep_rounding_remainders
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033] ### System information Win11 - Godot 4.5 Stable - Forward+ & Compatibility - AMD Radeon RX 7900 GRE ### Issue description I believe this isn't limited to monospaced font specifically, but since it's hard to visually identify this issue with non-monospaced fonts - I'll address this issue to monospaced font specifically.
MRE vid: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2eeb29c3-8372-4dc5-8e5b-a1d27a24ebfe
More noticable case: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1263cc1d-5a7a-4b7c-b732-9d62c54d54db
from [docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_fontfile.html#class-fontfile-property-keep-rounding-remainders): bool keep_rounding_remainders = true If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled. But in actuality, this setting affects monospaced fonts regardless of `subpixel_positioning` value, causing width change for hypen in label node as shown when left enabled. ### Steps to reproduce Use monospaced font in label with `keep_rounding_remainders` import option enabled (default). ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [monospace-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22948388/monospace-bug.zip) Using following fonts: - Jetbrains Mono - Kode Mono - VT323
